title: Bobby Charlton's birth chart
metaDescription: Bobby Charlton's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 17.8° Libra. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: 0.1° separates Venus and Neptune from an exact conjunction; at that range taste and imagination read as one mechanism. A conjunction concentrates rather than balances — the pair burns one fuel line.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 17.8° Libra — deep enough in the second decan (10°–20°) that Saturn, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 5.1° Libra, Venus at 19.9° Virgo, Mars at 7.6° Capricorn. Mercury in a air sign reads as thought that travels by comparison; Venus in a earth sign reads as attraction that grows by reliability; Mars in a earth sign reads as effort banked steadily until it tells.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Venus to Neptune is the closest call of the day, a conjunction within 0.1°. A conjunction is the least negotiable aspect in the scheme — no distance to argue across, so the pair arrives as a single instinct. Behind it, Saturn trine Pluto at 0.4°, and the Sun square Jupiter at 0.9° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: No closed figure — no grand trine, t-square, or grand cross — holds among the day-stable angles. The chart distributes its tension pair by pair rather than through one standing structure.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags five placements in this chart. The Sun in Libra at 17.8° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Virgo at 19.9° is in fall; Mars in Capricorn at 7.6° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Jupiter in Capricorn at 18.7° is in fall; Saturn in Aries at 0.5° is in fall. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 5 earth, 2 air, 2 fire; by modality, 5 cardinal, 2 mutable, 2 fixed. An earth emphasis reads as patience with material reality — slow hands, durable results. No settled placement falls in water — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Saturn and Uranus were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Sagittarius into Capricorn during that day at the birthplace, travelling 11.9° between one midnight and the next. The hour would decide it; no hour was recorded. The reading keeps the question open rather than flipping a coin dressed as astrology.
